name: Raymond Realty Ltd
title: Raymond Realty Ltd - 544420 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Pre-sales-led growth with JDA mix now 54% of FY26 bookings and FY26 EBITDA margin ~16%, guided 16-18% for FY27; management expects cash-negative operations for two years and Thane pre-sales flat at INR1,300-1,500 crore.

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 16-18%
triggers.quote: my suggestion or guidance would be to assume between 16 % and 18 % as the EBITDA margin on a blended basis for FY27

triggers.label: Cash-negative for two years
triggers.quote: for the next two years, we will be cash negative on an overall basis but internal accruals will keep on growing

triggers.label: Thane pricing growth limited
triggers.quote: Thane has remained more or less very marginal increase in prices over the years

guidance.quote: between 16 % and 18 % as the EBITDA margin on a blended basis for FY27

guidance.metric: Minimum annual growth in pre-sales and top line
guidance.quote: we've always given a guidance that you can expect a minimum 20% growth from us on the pre-sales number and on the top-line as well
INR1,300 to INR1,500 crores I think is an achievable number

prior_guidance_check.quote: last year we had guided for 5,000 to 10,000 additions of new GDV. We did 3,000

prior_guidance_check.metric: Own land vs JDA 50-50 mix by FY27
prior_guidance_check.quote: we have achieved this milestone one year ahead of schedule in FY26 itself

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow FY26
red_flags.quote: operating cash flow has been negative due to growth investments and approvals

red_flags.label: Thane pre-sales declining FY24-FY26
red_flags.quote: then we have done only INR1,360 crores in FY26 in Thane

evasions.quote: So, competition, yes, is there, but it's always been there.
the short answer to your question is going forward for the next two years, we will be cash negative on an overall basis
